page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It features 104 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped directly to 104 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is provisioned with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance type.

The low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1.85 GB per core represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing raw parallel integer and floating-point execution over memory-intensive caching or large in-memory database operations. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high compute density make it suitable for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, high-performance computing node tasks, physical simulations, and CPU-bound web serving or compilation tasks.
